metadata.description: Captured GET /api/mdm/updates/deployments/{uuid} after PUT /api/mdm/updates/deployments/{uuid} against 26.4.0.0. FINDING: ranking field is silently ignored by the PUT endpoint (204 returned, but ranking remained 1, not the 2 sent in the body). This is consistent with the canonical model: DeviceUpdateDeploymentUpdateV1Model has no ranking field — ranking is managed exclusively via the bulk-rank endpoint (PUT /api/mdm/updates/{uuid}/groups/{ogUuid}/deployments/bulk-rank). Sending ranking in the PUT body is silently dropped. priority remains absent (consistent with Questions A & B findings). Real UUIDs anonymized.
